fold_limitations: Family total 353/430 pools four refits. Normal alert counts must stay alongside each fold, not alongside a pooled total.
Attacker total 216/430 pools three refits. 125/7400 medium-plus alerts (122 high) belong to the held-out May model; October and April folds have 0 and 6 respectively.
Prior audit printed thresholds to four decimal places and did not save these refitted model weights. Exact threshold and model hashes are unavailable; no refits were run to recreate them.
The two May families share a funder. Family holdout therefore measures transfer within a funding-linked actor cluster, not demonstrated unseen-attacker generalization.

full_fit_candidate.use: Rejected full-fit model only; these false-alert counts do not belong to the family or attacker folds.

common_funder.interpretation: Observed common funding supports grouping the two May campaigns as one actor cluster; shared human operator identity is not proved.
